name: Groundbook
description:
Groundbook reviews construction drawings the way a careful engineer would. It reads every sheet and cross-checks plans, sections, details, schedules, and notes against each other and against the specifications; runs your review checklist over the set; and checks the drawings against building codes: public codes, code books you upload, or codes you hold a license for. Every conflict is listed with the exact sheet and text it came from, and the findings become an issue list your team works through, with a PDF report and marked-up drawings to share.

Connect it to Claude and it works in your projects with exactly your permissions:
• List your projects and their status.
• See open issues ranked by severity, with sheet numbers, or open one issue with its description, impact, recommended fix, and the cited drawing text.
• Change an issue's status or severity, add labels, comment, and assign it to a teammate.
• Create a project, set the review checklist, add saved files and building codes, and start a check.
• Ask plain-language questions about a project's drawings.
• Export a PDF report, marked-up drawings, a Bluebeam FDF, or a CSV; the file is ready on the website.

Nothing is visible in Claude that is not visible on the website. Read-only tools run without confirmation; anything that changes data asks first, and deletions are marked so Claude confirms. You can disconnect Claude at any time from Settings.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Groundbook to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Groundbook to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.groundbook.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Groundbook MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Groundbook lists 26 MCP tools, including add_code_source, add_saved_files_to_project, ask, assign_issue, comment_on_issue, create_project, delete_project, export_issues, get_export, get_issue, get_me, and get_project.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Groundbook?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Groundbook in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Groundbook requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Groundbook is developed by Groundbook AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
